Definition
[Finite-propagation class] Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0006 1. Definition 1.1\group section-1

We say \begin{equation} \tag {1.6} f \in \Tscr _1^k, \end{equation} provided that $f$ is even and, for each $I = (-\varepsilon , \varepsilon )$, \begin{equation} \tag {1.7} \left(\frac{d}{ds}\right)^l \hat{f}(s) \in L^1(\R \setminus I), \qquad 0 \leq l \leq k. \end{equation}
